title: One-Step Unary Normalization
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. Reinterpreting the successor configuration after one step of the input-normalized machine from $c$ on the all-ones input of length $|x|$ gives the successor after one step of $M$ from the unary reinterpretation of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet
A configuration of the machine on $x$
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine over the binary alphabet and $d$ a configuration on an input $x$. The unary reinterpretation of one step of the input-normalized variant of $M$ at $d$ equals one native step of $M$ at the unary reinterpretation of $d$, including the absorbing halted case.
